title: Hearty Buttery Ethiopian Peanuts Shiro
description: A rich and creamy Ethiopian dish featuring peanuts in a buttery mother sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This sugar-free friendly recipe is served in a mason jar.
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the saucepan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the peanuts, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the peanuts are tender.
Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until melted.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Ladle the shiro into a mason jar and serve hot.
